title: Conditions on Which the Particulars of a Car Rental May Be Changed
content:
Collection and return times and branches may be changed within the rate class's ceiling on modifications,
and the rental is re-priced at the class's rate for the new period. These are the terms on which a
Car Rental Rate Classes agreement is altered before collection.

1. A change carries the class's modification fee, and the difference in rate is collected or returned in
   addition to it. The fee and the rate difference are two separate sums and neither replaces the other.
2. The main driver may be replaced without charge on every class, provided the replacement meets the
   class's age range; a replacement outside the range is refused.
3. Adding or removing an additional driver is not a modification and carries only the per-day driver fee for
   the days the driver is named.
4. Correcting the contact address or contact number is free on every class and never counts toward the
   modification ceiling.
5. A change requested after the scheduled collection time has passed is not a modification: the renter
   collects as booked or is recorded as a no-show.

## Which changes count against the ceiling

| Change requested | Counts against the class's ceiling | Carries the modification fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| moving the collection or return time | yes | yes |
| moving the collection or return branch | yes | yes |
| replacing the main driver with one inside the class's age range | no | no |
| adding or removing an additional driver | no | no |
| correcting the contact address or number | no | no |

A replacement main driver outside the class's age range is refused, and the rental stands as booked.
